sql: SELECT ts_doy, ts_hour, wtmp_c, ROUND(wtmp_c * 9.0/5.0 + 32, 1) as wtmp_f FROM pier WHERE avail_t <= 516.875 ORDER BY ts_t DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT fish_date_doy, cls, COUNT(DISTINCT landing || '_' || boat) as boats, COUNT(*) as trips, SUM(yt) as total_yt, ROUND(AVG(yt), 2) as avg_yt_per_trip, ROUND(SUM(yt) / CAST(SUM(anglers) AS FLOAT), 2) as yt_per_angler FROM trips WHERE fish_date_doy >= 138 AND avail_t <= 516.875 GROUP BY fish_date_doy, cls ORDER BY fish_date_doy DESC, cls
SELECT index_id, value, avail_doy FROM climate WHERE index_id = 'oni' AND avail_t <= 516.875 ORDER BY avail_t DESC LIMIT 5
